_readme: Allow-lists for `locale-quality.test.ts`. Two rules, each with its exceptions:
identicalToEnglish - a value literally equal to en.json is an untranslated
string unless it is listed here with one of five reasons (the web app's
unit       - a unit, ratio or colour-space name written the same everywhere
identifier - an ALL-CAPS card label or a data field name used as a token
brand      - a product, company or platform name
cognate    - the word exists, spelled identically, in that language
"*" lists keys identical in every locale by design. `manual.<topic>.name`
is command syntax and is exempt by rule, not listed.
sameEnglish - keys that share ONE English value share one value per locale,
unless the group is listed with the two jobs the English label is doing.
An entry that no longer applies fails the test, so this file cannot rot.
Seeded 2026-09-20; every cognate and every same-English group was read in
context by a reviewer at native level

*.about.title: brand - the bot's name (zh adds 机器人)
*.card.perDe: unit - gil per delta-E column header
*.firstRun.title: brand - product name and version
*.matchImageHelp.supportedFormatsContent: format - a list of file-format names

de.card.swatchSlot: identifier - ALL-CAPS card column; 'Slot' is Duden-listed German
de.preferences.filters.labels.metallic: cognate - core's own German label is 'Metallic'
de.preset.name: cognate - 'Name' is German

RATIO.*: the contrast card's wide column header vs its narrow in-cell label - both reach one generator

TARGET.*: target colour (sheet and extractor cards) vs the target-dye row of the budget ledger
